title: A Replica Exchange Markov Chain Monte Carlo Method for Disconnected Implicit Manifolds via Tubular Relaxation
summary: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods provide powerful framework for sampling unknown probability measures across a wide range of scientific applications. In some settings, the target distribution is supported on a lower-dimensional submanifold of Euclidean space defined by nonlinear constraints, motivating the development of constrained Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (CHMC) methods. Most existing CHMC algorithms rely on the assumption that the implicit manifold is connected, allowing local constrained integrators such as RATTLE to explore the posterior ergodically.
